channel.title: Darren Moser / Dr. Sci-Fi
channel.description:
If you've come looking for science fiction creations and robot woodworking then subscribe now, don't delay.
Every other week I'll share one of my sci-fi or shop projects. My specialty is full-size Droids from EVA foam. I hope you enjoy these stories and make, share and support with the maker community.

videos.t: Earl Grey 69: A Klingon Challenge - VHS Board Game
Thank you Lucasfilm for a simple gift to my NICU son Peter
videos.desc:
I can barely convey the kindness of such an unexpected gift. My son Peter received a care package from Lucasfilm and I am simply blown away. Peter is 3 weeks old and hasn't traveled home from the NICU hospital yet. Waiting for him is an adorable "Rey" bear, Star Wars shirts and toys. 
Thank you to my 501st brothers and sisters who I know helped make sure this package arrived on my doorstep. I am grateful for your friendship and support through this past month. Thank you ‪Lucasfilm‬, from the Moser family. May the Force be with you.

videos.t: L3 The Audition
videos.desc:
This was my submission for the 2018 Star Wars Fan Awards. It wasn't a finalist so I'm posting it here for Star Wars fans to enjoy. I got this idea from an interview with Phoebe where she described her audition process for L3-37 and not knowing what a droid was.
I completed my L3-37 costume this year in 3 months for the Solo: A Star Wars Story premiere. L3 is so fun and a great character. Thank you Phoebe Waller-Bridge for your amazing work.
See more pictures of my costume here http://drscifi.com/l337

videos.t: Ceti Alpha 3 - Episode 239 TNG Title Screen Game
videos.desc: The trio takes a break from "new Trek episodes reviews" to play a game. Can Phillip and Daniel guess the title of a "Star Trek: The Next Generation" story merely by looking at the episode's first image? Darren blurs the title cards from several episodes as his co-hosts try to name the right episode -- will they get it right? Will they guess every episode from an entire season? How many shots of the Enterprise-D at warp exist? All these questions and more are answered in this game.
